narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='m1'/>Both are greater than nine, since multiplying always makes the answer bigger.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>But two thirds of nine is less than nine itself.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>Two thirds of anything is less than all of it.

narration: <bookmark mark='m1'/>Between zero and one, the product is less than the other number. Above one, it is greater.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>Your turn. Is one third times seven less than seven, or greater?
